intro.h2: From 70s disaster to a space you love
paragraphs: Compass Bath and Remodel does bathroom remodeling Utah families describe as a full transformation. One client's dad had a master bath with 70s shag carpet, a rotting subfloor and a dropped ceiling. Russ turned it into what she called a royal jewel of a space, with blue stone-look tile and brass fixtures.

What reviewers return to is how the job is run. Russ shows up in person, listens to your ideas and adds his own. In one case he had a draft plan and estimate ready the next day. During the work he tells you what to expect in the coming week, and clients say each step is well coordinated.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling Utah homes, start to finish

items.name: Master bathroom remodels
items.blurb: Full master bath remodels, including the hard parts: rotted subfloors, old dropped ceilings and dated layouts. Recent work includes a glass walk-in shower with blue stone-look tile and brushed brass hardware, paired with a dark wood double vanity.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with frosted glass sliding door on brass rail, blue stone-look wall tile and brass shower set

items.name: Walk-in showers
items.blurb: Tub-to-shower conversions and new walk-in showers, with built-in niches, a seat and grab bars where you need them. One shower uses large marble-look wall panels, a corner bench and a handheld shower on a slide bar.

image.alt: Walk-in shower with marble-look wall panels, built-in seat, recessed niche, grab bars and handheld shower

items.name: Vanity replacement
items.blurb: New vanities, tops, faucets and mirrors to update a bathroom without a full gut. Past jobs include a dark wood double vanity with white top and oval brass mirrors, and a white shaker double vanity with a wide mirror.

image.alt: Dark wood double vanity with white quartz-look top, brushed brass faucets and two oval brass mirrors

items.name: Tubs and tub surrounds
items.blurb: New drop-in and alcove tubs with clean white surrounds. One master bath remodel set a deep soaking tub into a wide ledge under a large window, so the bath gets daylight and a view while you soak.

image.alt: White soaking tub set into a wide ledge beneath a large window, with chrome tub filler

items.name: Kitchen remodeling
items.blurb: Bathrooms are the main work, but Compass also remodels kitchens, and kitchen remodels come up in several Google reviews. Call Russ to talk through cabinets, counters and layout, and ask to see photos of recent kitchen projects.

why_choose_us.h2: Why homeowners recommend Russ and his crew

items.title: Weekly updates you can plan around
items.text: Clients say Russ lets them know what to expect in the upcoming week and answers questions quickly. Communication from before the start to completion is a common theme.

items.title: A plan before the work starts
items.text: Russ surveys the job in person, listens to your ideas, offers his own, and puts a draft plan and estimate in front of you, in one case the very next day.

items.title: Creative with tricky rooms
items.text: Rotting subfloors, dropped ceilings and unusual family needs do not throw him. One client praised his patience and creative solutions for a bespoke situation.

items.title: 29 reviews, all five stars
items.text: Every Google review is five stars. Bathroom remodels come up in 12 of them, kitchen remodels in 4, walk-in showers in 3 and vanity replacement in 2.

about.text: Compass Bath and Remodel, LLC is Russ Nay's remodeling company, focused on bathrooms with kitchen work as well. Russ meets clients in person, walks the space, and works out the plan with them before the crew starts. Clients describe him as quick to respond, flexible, and someone with an eye for detail who does not miss a thing. His associates get the same praise: personable and professional. One homeowner enjoyed watching the process so much that he is keeping Russ's number handy for the next project.
about.owner_role: Runs the company and leads the crew

items.name: Sarah I.
items.text: Russ at Compass Bath and Remodel did a fantastic job working with us on my dad's master bath remodel. He made a 70s era shag carpet disaster with a rotting subfloor and a dropped ceiling into a royal jewel of a space. He was communicative, letting us know what to expect in the upcoming week, responsive to our questions, patient with our unique situation, and up to the task of coming up with creative solutions to what became a bespoke situation. I would definitely recommend Russ and team.

items.name: RP D.
items.text: I stumbled on Compass Bath and Remodel quite by accident, and I’m glad I did. Russ Nay and his associates did a tremendous job remodeling my master bath. I got a great impression of Russ from the start. He was quick to respond, showed up in person to survey the job, listened intently to my ideas, offered up some of his own, and had a draft plan and estimate ready the next day. He has an eye for detail, and didn’t miss a thing. Russ was flexible and adaptable, and each step in the process was well coordinated. He and all of his associates were very personable and professional. I actually enjoyed watching the process; it was a great experience. I’ll be keeping his contact info readily available so I can call him again for future projects.

items.name: Jeff M.
items.text: Compass Bath and Remodel did our recent bathroom remodel. My wife and I are very happy with the results. Russ and the rest of his crew were awesome! The communication with us before the remodel started until the completion of the project was great. It was obvious he cared about us being satisfied with the work and time frame in which it would be completed. We would highly recommend them to anyone looking for a remodel.

service_area.text: Compass Bath and Remodel is a Utah company reached on an 801 number. Google does not list a street address or a set list of towns, because Russ comes to you: he surveys jobs in person at the home. Call (801) 678-2880 with your city and a short description of your bathroom or kitchen, and he will tell you whether the project fits his schedule.

items.q: What projects do you take on?
items.a: Mostly bathrooms: full master bath remodels, walk-in showers, tub replacements and vanity replacements. Compass also does kitchen remodels. Google reviews mention bathroom remodels most often, followed by kitchen remodels, walk-in showers and vanity replacement, so you can see the work clients hire Russ for.

items.q: My bathroom has old damage. Can you still remodel it?
items.a: Yes. One master bath had 70s shag carpet, a rotting subfloor and a dropped ceiling, and Russ rebuilt it into a bright new room with a glass walk-in shower. He found creative solutions when the job turned into what the family called a bespoke situation.

items.q: How quickly do I get a plan and estimate?
items.a: Russ visits in person to survey the job, listens to your ideas and then prepares a draft plan and estimate. One client said he had both ready the day after the visit. Call (801) 678-2880 to set up the visit at a time that works for you.

items.q: Will I know what is happening during the remodel?
items.a: Clients say yes. Russ lets you know what to expect in the upcoming week and responds quickly to questions. One couple said communication was great from before the remodel started until it was finished, and that he clearly cared about the work and the timeline.

Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM. Compass is closed on Saturday and Sunday. You can email russ.compassbathandremodel@gmail.com at any time with photos of your bathroom and a few notes, and Russ will follow up during business hours.
